title: ResQAdam: Residual-Preserving Adaptive Optimization for Memory-Efficient Quantization Aware Training
abstract: arXiv:2611.08924v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Quantization-aware training (QAT) is the most reliable way to obtain accurate low-bit large language models (LLMs), but training with AdamW keeps two dense FP32 states for every weight matrix. We find that low-rank memory-efficient optimizers such as GaLore and LDAdam degrade substantially in QAT. A considerable part of the QAT momentum lies outside its top-r singular subspace, and projection-based methods discard this part at every step. We further observe that this residual remains useful when only its sign is kept. Based on these observations, we propose ResQAdam. It keeps a single BF16 momentum, applies Adam only to the r x r coordinates of the principal subspace, and adds a normalized sign update computed from the residual. We evaluate ResQAdam with two from-scratch QAT methods and three QAT fine-tuning pipelines, with weights quantized down to 2 bits. It reduces optimizer-state memory by 71% to 74% relative to AdamW, stays close

translated_title: ResQAdam：面向内存高效量化感知训练的残差保持自适应优化
translated_abstract: 量化感知训练（QAT）是获得精确低比特大语言模型（LLMs）最可靠的方法，但使用AdamW训练时，每个权重矩阵都需要维护两个密集的FP32状态。我们发现GaLore和LDAdam等低秩内存高效优化器在QAT中性能大幅下降。相当一部分QAT动量位于其前r个奇异子空间之外，而基于投影的方法在每一步都会丢弃这部分信息。我们进一步观察到，即使仅保留残差的符号，这部分残差仍然有用。基于这些观察，我们提出了ResQAdam。它仅维护单个BF16动量，只对主子空间的r×r坐标应用Adam，并添加一个由残差计算得到的归一化符号更新。我们使用两种从头训练的QAT方法和三种QAT微调流程评估了ResQAdam，权重被量化至2比特。与AdamW相比，该方法将优化器状态内存减少了71%至74%，同时保持性能接近……
tldr: ResQAdam通过仅维护单个BF16动量、只对主子空间的r×r坐标应用Adam，并利用残差的归一化符号更新来保留被投影方法丢弃的动量信息，在权重量化至2比特的量化感知训练中将优化器状态内存相比AdamW减少71%至74%，同时保持接近的性能。
en_tdlr: ResQAdam preserves the momentum residual discarded by projection-based methods through a normalized sign update, applying Adam only to the principal subspace with a single BF16 momentum, which reduces optimizer-state memory by 71%-74% versus AdamW while maintaining near-identical performance for 2-bit quantization-aware training of large language models.
